mostWorthwhile.text: The ending’s image of a creature learning a song brought the creation myth’s theme of a world continuing on its own into focus.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final chapter offered no actions or goals, so there was no gameplay passage to evaluate.

surprise.text: The story ended with the world still changing rather than presenting creation as a finished product.

arbitrary.text: No action was available in this chapter, so I cannot identify one that felt arbitrary.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the world makes next, though this ending feels complete and gives me no gameplay experience in this chapter to judge.
